Keep generous transparent margins within each cell, no overlap. CONSISTENT semi-realistic hand painted premium Japanese RPG illustration, realistic adult proportions 6.5 to 7 heads tall (NOT chibi), expressive natural faces, detailed leather cloth and metal, subtle soft brushwork, warm golden key light upper left, cool teal shadows, restrained gold embroidery. backgrounds: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background atlas for a Japanese mobile fantasy RPG. Create ONE landscape image divided into exactly FOUR equal rectangular illustrations in a precise 2 columns by 2 rows grid, no gutters, no borders, no text. Consistent semi-realistic hand-painted Japanese RPG illustration, natural textures, gentle brushwork, warm golden afternoon light from upper left, soft teal shadows, atmospheric perspective. No people, no monsters, no UI, no magical effects. Each scene composed as a playable battle backdrop with open level stone/earth foreground occupying bottom 35%, calm empty central space for characters, layered scenic distance. TOP LEFT: coastal path in Kyushu with sunlit pale stone, sea and distant Japanese-inspired harbor roofs, turquoise water and green cliff. TOP RIGHT: tranquil forest clearing, ancient broadleaf trees and shafts of warm sun through leaves, moss stone and ferns along edges. BOTTOM LEFT: mountain pass with distant dramatic green mountain ridges, old stone path and grasses, high airy sky. BOTTOM RIGHT: open meadow path with warm grasses, distant Japanese fantasy town timber roofs and green hills, beautiful pale clouds. Avoid photorealism and chibi/pixel art. Premium semi-real fantasy game environment concept art. Each quadrant must work independently when cropped.
back: Edit the character atlas: preserve the exact 4x3 layout, identities, clothes, colors, proportions and transparency; turn all figures to back view.
processing: Alpha-trim each equal cell; encode two transparent atlases as WebP quality 88 and four background quadrants as WebP quality 84 using @napi-rs/canvas. Source bounds are in src/semireal_frames.js.
